
# "بكرة هنعمل إيه؟ — The future tense (practice)" {.unnumbered}

## How the future works

In Egyptian Arabic, the present and the future share the **same verb stem and the same personal prefixes**. The only thing that changes is the particle at the front of the verb:

- The **present** uses **بـ (bi-)** for habits and ongoing actions — أنا بسافر (*ana basafir*) = "I travel / I'm travelling".
- The **future** uses **هـ (ha-)** for plans and intentions — أنا هسافر (*ana hasafir*) = "I will travel".

So to build the future, take the present, drop the بـ, and add هـ. The personal prefixes (*a-, te-, ye-, ne-*) stay exactly the same — only the front particle changes. (Some people write the future with **حـ** *ḥa-* instead of هـ; they mean the same thing.)

## Examples — present vs. future

[أكل — eat]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا باكل سمك كل يوم</summary>
<span class="fr">ana bakol samak koll yom</span>
<span class="en">I eat fish every day (habit → بـ)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا هاكل سمك بكرة</summary>
<span class="fr">ana hakol samak bukra</span>
<span class="en">I will eat fish tomorrow (plan → هـ)</span>
</details>

[شرب — drink]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">
<summary>هو بيشرب قهوة الصبح</summary>
<span class="fr">huwwa beyeshrab 2ahwa es-sob7</span>
<span class="en">he drinks coffee in the morning (habit → بـ)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>هو هيشرب قهوة بكرة الصبح</summary>
<span class="fr">huwwa hayeshrab 2ahwa bukra es-sob7</span>
<span class="en">he'll drink coffee tomorrow morning (plan → هـ)</span>
</details>

[راح — go]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">
<summary>إحنا بنروح السينما كل أسبوع</summary>
<span class="fr">e7na binru7 es-sinema koll osbo3</span>
<span class="en">we go to the cinema every week (habit → بـ)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>إحنا هنروح السينما الأسبوع الجاي</summary>
<span class="fr">e7na hanru7 es-sinema el-osbo3 el-gay</span>
<span class="en">we'll go to the cinema next week (plan → هـ)</span>
</details>

## The dialogue — الديالوج (كتاب كلمني عربي)

<details class="frase">
<summary>أحمد: بكرة هسافر إسكندرية بالقطر الصبح.</summary>
<span class="fr">Ahmad: bukra hasafir Eskendereyya bel-2atr es-sob7.</span>
<span class="en">Ahmed: Tomorrow I'll travel to Alexandria by train in the morning.</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>منى: يا بختك! هتقعد هناك قد إيه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">Mona: ya ba5tak! hato23od henak 2add eh?</span>
<span class="en">Mona: Lucky you! How long will you stay there?</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>أحمد: هقعد أسبوع، و هعوم في البحر كل يوم.</summary>
<span class="fr">Ahmad: ha23od osbo3, we ha3oom fel-ba7r koll yom.</span>
<span class="en">Ahmed: I'll stay a week, and swim in the sea every day.</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>منى: طيب، أنا هخلص شغل بكرة و هكلمك عشان نتقابل.</summary>
<span class="fr">Mona: tayyeb, ana ha5allas sho8l bukra we hakallemak 3ashan net2abel.</span>
<span class="en">Mona: Okay, I'll finish work tomorrow and call you so we can meet.</span>
</details>

## Verbs from the dialogue

The dialogue is built on four verbs. Here they are conjugated first in the present, then in the future — see how only the front particle changes (بـ → هـ).

**Present (بـ)**

| Pronoun | سافر · travel | قعد · stay | عام · swim | خلّص · finish |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| أنا | بسافر - basafir | بقعد - ba23od | بعوم - ba3oom | بخلص - ba5allas |
| إنت | بتسافر - betsafir | بتقعد - beto23od | بتعوم - bet3oom | بتخلص - bet5allas |
| إنتِ | بتسافري - betsafri | بتقعدي - beto23odi | بتعومي - bet3oomi | بتخلصي - bet5allasi |
| هو | بيسافر - beysafir | بيقعد - beyo23od | بيعوم - bey3oom | بيخلص - bey5allas |
| هي | بتسافر - betsafir | بتقعد - beto23od | بتعوم - bet3oom | بتخلص - bet5allas |
| إحنا | بنسافر - bensafir | بنقعد - beno23od | بنعوم - ben3oom | بنخلص - ben5allas |
| إنتو | بتسافروا - betsafru | بتقعدوا - beto23odu | بتعوموا - bet3oomu | بتخلصوا - bet5allasu |
| هم | بيسافروا - beysafru | بيقعدوا - beyo23odu | بيعوموا - bey3oomu | بيخلصوا - bey5allasu |

**Future (هـ)**

| Pronoun | سافر · travel | قعد · stay | عام · swim | خلّص · finish |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| أنا | هسافر - hasafir | هقعد - ha23od | هعوم - ha3oom | هخلص - ha5allas |
| إنت | هتسافر - hatsafir | هتقعد - hato23od | هتعوم - hat3oom | هتخلص - hat5allas |
| إنتِ | هتسافري - hatsafri | هتقعدي - hato23odi | هتعومي - hat3oomi | هتخلصي - hat5allasi |
| هو | هيسافر - haysafir | هيقعد - hayo23od | هيعوم - hay3oom | هيخلص - hay5allas |
| هي | هتسافر - hatsafir | هتقعد - hato23od | هتعوم - hat3oom | هتخلص - hat5allas |
| إحنا | هنسافر - hansafir | هنقعد - hano23od | هنعوم - han3oom | هنخلص - han5allas |
| إنتو | هتسافروا - hatsafru | هتقعدوا - hato23odu | هتعوموا - hat3oomu | هتخلصوا - hat5allasu |
| هم | هيسافروا - haysafru | هيقعدوا - hayo23odu | هيعوموا - hay3oomu | هيخلصوا - hay5allasu |

## Practice — build your own future sentences

Use the toolkit below: pick a **verb**, put it in the future (هـ + present), add a **noun** and a **time adverb**.

**Time adverbs**

| Árabe | Franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| دلوقتي | delwa2ti | now |
| النهارده | en-naharda | today |
| بعدين | ba3den | later |
| بعد شوية | ba3d shuwayya | in a little while |
| بكرة | bukra | tomorrow |
| بعد بكرة | ba3d bukra | the day after tomorrow |
| الأسبوع الجاي | el-osbo3 el-gay | next week |
| الشهر الجاي | esh-shahr el-gay | next month |
| من شوية | min shuwayya | a little while ago |
| إمبارح | embare7 | yesterday |
| أول إمبارح | awwel embare7 | the day before yesterday |
| الأسبوع اللي فات | el-osbo3 elli fat | last week |
| من زمان | min zaman | a long time ago |
| دايماً | dayman | always |
| كتير | kteer | often |
| نادراً | nadran | rarely |
| أبداً | abadan | never (with a negative verb) |

**New verbs to try** (present tense given; just swap بـ for هـ to make the future)

| Árabe | Franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| بيعزف | beye3zef | plays (an instrument) |
| بياكل | beyakol | eats |
| بيلعب | beyel3ab | plays (a game / sport) |
| بيكتب | beyekteb | writes |

**Vocabulary**

| Árabe | Franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| بيانو | biano | piano |
| سمك | samak | fish |
| كورة | koora | football |
| كتاب | ketab | book |
| قهوة | 2ahwa | coffee |
| جواب | gawab | letter |

**Your task:** make future sentences of your own. Try to read the Arabic models first, then open them to check. For example:

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا هعزف بيانو بكرة</summary>
<span class="fr">ana ha3zef biano bukra</span>
<span class="en">I'll play the piano tomorrow</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>هاكل سمك بعدين</summary>
<span class="fr">hakol samak ba3den</span>
<span class="en">I'll eat fish later</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>هم هيلعبوا كورة الأسبوع الجاي</summary>
<span class="fr">humma hayel3abu koora el-osbo3 el-gay</span>
<span class="en">they'll play football next week</span>
</details>
